message: The other day, I was scrolling through weather alerts while sipping my coffee, feeling all tech-savvy and prepared for a storm. Suddenly, my phone blinked out like it had a mind of its own – no charge, just a black screen. I ended up digging out an old radio from the back of the cupboard to keep track of the weather updates. Lesson learned: sometimes, the best backup is a good old-fashioned plan B. Have you ever had a tech fail at just the right moment? 📻
